tools.name: search-documents
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find, search, or browse study documents, lecture notes, summaries, or course materials on Studocu. Pass topic/keywords as `query` only — never put course name, course id, or institution name in `query`. `institution` is a display name only (this tool has no institutio

tools.name: search-institutions
tools.description: Search Studocu institutions by name when establishing or correcting education context (onboarding / context setup). Do not require this before every document search. Structured results include id, name, type, region_code, and country for follow-up tools. When talking to the user, present name/type/c

tools.name: search-courses
tools.description: Search Studocu courses when establishing or correcting course context. Prefer institution_id from search-institutions to scope results. Omit institution_id only when the institution is unknown: results then include catalog institution_id, and institution_name when Algolia has it. Do not require this

tools.name: search-web
tools.description: Answer open-web questions with a grounded response and citation URLs (news, reference sites, documentation). Use this for non-Studocu sources. For Studocu study documents, lecture notes, summaries, or course materials, use search-documents instead. Competitor study-material domains are excluded from

tools.name: get-course-syllabus
tools.description: Return a generated course outline as markdown when this tool has one. This is the best grounding for high-quality study guidance. Requires course_id.

tools.name: agent-os-session
tools.description: Use this proof tool to verify that the Agent OS MCP server received a valid delegated Studocu session.

tools.name: read-web-url
tools.description: Read a specific public URL and return grounded page content for agent evidence. Use this when you already have the exact URL. For Studocu study documents use search-documents; for open-web discovery use search-web. Competitor study-material hosts are rejected.

tools.name: read-artifact
tools.description: Read a Studocu project source or creation by its studocu://project/{project_id}/{kind}/{uuid} URI. Returns normalized metadata with explicitly mapped inline content.

tools.name: read-detached-document
tools.description: Read a Studocu document directly, without requiring or creating a project source. Use read-artifact for documents attached to a project.

tools.name: get-context
tools.description: Return the unified Agent OS context manifest for the authenticated user: profile, followed courses, project metadata, and recent activity. Every project includes has_course_mastery and started_course_mastery (course supports Infinite Practice / learner has started it). Course mastery is visible only

tools.name: get-project-state
tools.description: Return sources and creations (project state) for one or more projects by id. Creation rows may include external_id (quizId or mockExamId) so a request-creation creating response can be matched once Alpha identity appears. Use after get-context (which lists projects without their sources/creations) t

tools.name: get-course-mastery
tools.description: Return practised-topic Infinite Practice mastery for a course (topic_id, topic_name when available, display 0–100, questions_answered). Use after get-context flags (has_course_mastery / started_course_mastery) or whenever context omitted topic_masteries. Agent OS is read-only: chatting, creating art

tools.name: write-artifact
tools.description: Create a Studocu artifact from typed content. Provide project_id and an artifact envelope; the artifact type defines the required content shape.

tools.name: add-document-sources
tools.description: Attach up to 10 Studocu documents from search-documents to a project. Returns the sources that were successfully added; compare with document_ids if some were omitted.

tools.name: create-project
tools.description: Create a Studocu project and optionally configure its emoji and course. A numeric course_id is validated before project creation.

tools.name: update-project
tools.description: Update a Studocu project title, emoji, or course. Use course_id null to clear the course and institution.

tools.name: request-creation
tools.description: Generate a Studocu quiz or mockExam from 1-10 project source artifacts. Waits up to ~3 minutes; returns artifact_id and external_id when created, status creating with external_id when persist is not yet visible, or outcome_unknown on client timeout or in-flight duplicate (check get-project-state bef

tools.name: read-memory
tools.description: Read durable agent memory for the authenticated user. Returns one document per (scope, kind); use project_id for project-scoped memory. Identity comes from Core via the session bearer, not from input.

tools.name: write-memory
tools.description: Upsert one durable memory document per (scope, kind) for the authenticated user. Provide project_id for project-local memory, or null/omit for global. Identity comes from Core via the session bearer, not from input.

tools.name: delete-memory
tools.description: Delete one durable memory document identified by (scope, kind) for the authenticated user. Provide project_id for project-local memory, or null/omit for global. Identity comes from Core via the session bearer, not from input.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-web, read-web-url, get-course-mastery · Private data: search-documents, search-institutions, search-courses, search-web, read-web-url, read-detached-document, add-document-sources, read-memory, write-memory, delete-memory · Public sink: get-context · Destructive: delete-memory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-web, read-web-url, get-course-mastery · Private data: search-documents, search-institutions, search-courses, search-web, read-web-url, read-detached-document, add-document-sources, read-memory, write-memory, delete-memory · Public sink: get-context · Destructive: delete-memory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
